concordance_component_example.interpretation: position of queried sign 1 inside composite 39 + 1

sequence_audit.conclusion: no per-sherd sign sequence or accession identifier is exposed

depth.note: filter results return raw numeric depths plus Surface/NA, not merely the 38 selection bands

graffiti.method: sample without replacement to the matched token count, then random token order reconstructed from the frequency spectrum

indus.method: sample without replacement to the matched token count, then random token order reconstructed from the frequency spectrum

indus.why_no_composites: the Indus catalogue has 44 multi-codepoint renderings, but they are not a base-indexed class commensurate with TNSDA graphical composites

stratigraphy.method: numeric depths converted to weighted within-stratum terciles; depths are permuted only within site x ware x habitation; strata require >=20 numeric-depth tokens

inventories.deduplication: exact normalized 64x64 pixel identity within category

control_metadata.extraction: dark strokes inside closed-and-eroded grey sherd v2

shape_control.metric: 64x64 aspect-preserving masks; symmetric centered chamfer exactly as src/shapes.py; aligned Dice with the same 0.90/1.00/1.10 scales and ±2-pixel shifts, screened to the 16 nearest chamfer candidates

complexity_matched_base_variant_vs_contr.balance_warning: poor common support; at least one absolute standardized mean difference exceeds 0.25

crosswalk.method: infer the nearest sign in this project's Parpola-derived font from TNSDA's paired Indus seal/pottery image, then rank that own-font target against every own-font sign for the paired graffiti glyph

glyph_source_check.reading: pixel agreement under the pre-existing note-17 allograph cut; zero/low agreement argues against identical modern glyph art, but does not prove independent archaeological exemplars
